n = int(input())

mod1 = 998244353
mod2 = 10**9 + 7
pw = [1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000]

s = [0] * 7
ans = 0
cnt1 = 0
cnt2 = 0
v = [[] for _ in range(7)]

def dfs1(k1, k2):
    global cnt1
    if k1 == 7:
        return
    v[k1].append((cnt1 - k2) % mod1)
    s[k1] += (cnt1 - k2) % mod1
    cnt1 += 1
    for i in range(10):
        dfs1(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i)

def check(x):
    return x * pw[6] + 999999 <= n and x * pw[6] * 10 > n

def dfs2(k1, k2):
    global ans, cnt2
    if k2 > n:
        return
    if check(k2):
        for i in range(7):
            p = ((cnt2 + 1 - (k2 * pw[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1
            # Find lower bound of p in v[i]
            from bisect import bisect_left
            w = bisect_left(v[i], p)
            ans += (s[i] + p * len(v[i]) - mod1 * (len(v[i]) - w)) % mod2
            ans %= mod2
        cnt2 += cnt1
        return
    cnt2 += 1
    ans += ((cnt2 - k2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1
    ans %= mod2
    for i in range(0 if k1 != 0 else 1, 10):
        dfs2(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i)

dfs1(0, 0)
for i in range(7):
    v[i].sort()
cnt2 = -1
dfs2(0, 0)
print(ans)
